# Engine

The engine (`src/engine`) owns deterministic, UI-independent game state and
rules. It may read static definitions from `src/data` but must never import
`src/ui`, `ink`, or `pixi.js`.

## State + reducer

`GameState` is a serializable tree: seed + RNG state, party, economy, inventory,
world, dungeon, battle, quests, log, and run flags. [`reduce(state, event)`](mex://function:e96e0f8f03a354c7b531617f6be534a2)
applies a typed `GameEvent` with no I/O and returns a new state; `GameStore`
validates each result and keeps a bounded debug journal. [`newGame(seed)`](mex://function:e0280160cef6b53fa0527ae801b75946)
builds the initial seeded state.

Determinism rules (non-negotiable):
- Random outcomes consume the serialized `Rng` state.
- Blocked/no-op actions are side-effect-free and consume **no** randomness.
- World layouts are reproducible from their seed inputs; no `Math.random`.

## Combat targeting

A `SkillDef.target` shape (`single`, `row`, `column`, `allEnemies`, `randomN`,
`self`, `ally`, `allAllies`) expands into a concrete target list through
[`resolveShapeTargets()`](mex://function:156f7e1cf6c4b61914f225116ab26138)
in `combat/resolution.ts` — the one resolver both a party member's `BattleSkill`
command and a monster's `advanceRound` turn use. Every resolved target rolls its
own crit, damage, and status independently — never one roll broadcast to a group.

- Enemies stand in front/back rows (`BattleEnemy.row`); a basic **attack**
  cannot reach a back-row enemy while any front-row enemy lives
  (`isMeleeTargetable`); **skills** ignore this and reach any row.
- Status effects (poison, burn, stun, slow, wet, oiled, chilled, frozen,
  shocked) tick at the start of the afflicted actor's turn and clear entirely
  when battle ends. Every Heal-kind skill also cleanses the caster's own
  statuses on cast.
- A monster with an attack-kind skill in `MonsterDef.skills` always casts one
  instead of a basic attack (see the Dungeon Guardian).

## Progression + skill tree

Warrior, Rogue, Wizard classes define starting stats, per-level growth, and
known skills in `CLASSES`; each carries a `treeId` into `SKILL_TREES`.
[`grantXp()`](mex://function:12d97fc8a68cceab82868d1070c4f39e) awards **one
skill point per level gained** on top of stat/HP/MP growth — never retroactively.
[`unlockSkillNode()`](mex://function:b1356f5dad73f326e406c96ffedd29c7) spends a
point on a node from the member's class tree, staying **pure on rejection**
(unknown node, already unlocked, missing prerequisite, insufficient points) and
returning a reason instead of throwing. A member's battle skill list
(`memberSkills`, `combat/skills.ts`) is `ClassDef.skills` plus every unlocked
active node's `skillId`; `effectiveStats` (`loot/equipment.ts`) adds every
unlocked passive node's stat delta on top of base + equipment. Both fall back to
pre-skill-tree behavior when a member has no unlocked nodes.

## Loot + quests

Loot combines item bases, rarity, prefixes, suffixes, and optional
monster-specific implicit properties. The Guild quest board (`quests.ts`) holds
up to 3 accepted quests; `advanceQuestsOnVictory` (inside `finalizeWon`) tallies
kill/clear/fetch progress and only spends fetch-drop RNG for kills an incomplete
accepted quest still needs — no RNG on quests nobody took.

## World

Overworld: passable biomes, a 2x2-footprint village (`world/landmarks.ts`),
reachable dungeon entrances, and a seeded encounter meter. Fast travel — evac
(leave a dungeon to its entrance tile) and zoom (teleport between visited
landmarks via `world/waypoints.ts`) — never triggers an encounter or advances
the meter. Dungeons are deterministic rooms/corridors/chests/stairs with a boss
floor.

## Persistence + defeat

The whole state serializes to one JSON blob (`persistence/serializer.ts`).
[`deserialize()`](mex://function:22ac98043e4c2c1c056d3b9fb19a3109) backfills
older saves with required run flags, the default Warrior class, and zero skill
points/unlocked nodes. Normal defeat revives the party in the village with 1 HP
and half its gold; permadeath ends the run and the UI then clears the save.
Victory awards XP, gold, and seeded loot before returning to the origin scene.

## Verify

- `pnpm test:unit` (engine + persistence tests are pure-function coverage).
- No `Math.random`; random outcomes consume `Rng`; blocked actions consume none.
- Engine imports nothing from `src/ui` / `ink` / `pixi.js`.
